attributes.whatsNew:
This build simplifies food selection and retains the existing DUO adaptation.

1. Food rows show only the icon and name; calorie, P/F/C and reference subtitles are removed.
2. The default list contains 100 common foods, prioritizing usage in your saved logs and filling remaining places from a starter list with Chinese display names.
3. Search still covers all 13,535 atlas records. Exact names and aliases rank first; up to 100 results are shown.
4. Nutrition data, unit conversion and saved totals remain intact.

Please test opening the list, common-food ordering, searching beyond the starter list, selecting amounts/units and saving. After upgrading, verify historical records and totals. On DUO, check the unfolded landscape two-column layout, folded/portrait single column and cards/charts after rotation.

本版优化食物选择列表，并保留现有DUO适配。

1. 每个食物仅显示图标和名称，移除热量、P/F/C和营养参考副标题。
2. 默认展示常用100项：按已记录食物的使用频次优先，其余由中文常见食物清单补足。
3. 搜索仍覆盖完整13,535条图谱记录；精确名称和别名优先，每次最多显示100项。
4. 食物营养数据、选择后的单位换算和保存统计保持完整。

请测试首次打开列表、常用排序、搜索列表外食物、选择后数量/单位和保存；升级后核对历史记录与合计。DUO请检查展开横屏双栏、收起/竖屏单栏以及旋转后的卡片与趋势图布局。
